story: A new user asks how to set up two-factor authentication. This is not really an incident — it's a how-to question. The agent should identify the user, check known issues (none for 2FA), get resolution steps for the access category (the steps guide through 2FA setup), and create a Low priority ticket for tracking. This tests whether the agent correctly classifies non-incident requests.

args.description: New user requesting guidance on setting up two-factor authentication. Provided step-by-step instructions. No system issues detected.

starting_sentence: I'm newuser@company.com, how do I set up two-factor authentication?
